title: [spec-gap][R-ADR-017/020] Appendix 7.6 test matrix drift: test_ccp16.py absent, rust/rpl+rust/gateway absent, <5% loss at 50 nodes/km2 unvalidated, no Renode density scenario
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:427-432 (Interop and Tests) plus line 419 cite obligations that do not exist as written: (1) pytest python/tests/sim/test_ccp16.py — does not exist; real ccp16.json consumers are python/tests/test_ccp.py:170-196, python/tests/test_channel_plan.py:276-345, python/tests/test_vectors.py:1815 (independent oracle). (2) cargo test in rust/rpl and rust/gateway — those crate paths do not exist (lichen-rpl, lichen-gateway) and neither consumes ccp16.json (tracked in b7z9.179). (3) Python sim/schc validates <5% loss at 50 nodes/km2 (line 419) — no such validation anywhere (rg km2 and 50-nodes zero hits; closest is test_density_aware_startup_staggering asserting collision_rate<0.5 with no area units, python/tests/sim/test_scale.py:349-423). (4) Renode scenarios for multi-node density test — every .resc in the repo is single-machine; zero ccp16/density mentions in renode files. Zephyr west/native_sim path exists via lichen/tests/rf_health_vectors. Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. Suggested: rename appendix paths to the real ones, add a 50-nodes-per-km2 <5% loss sim validation, add a multi-machine Renode density scenario, or amend the appendix.
